tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ auger init declares bundle and bundle_member idempotently and the live namespace exposes them at /api/ns/auger/tables; a bundle-scoped decision round-trips with scope intact; decision scope defaults to project with no behaviour change; a bundle_member naming a project absent from the scheduler DB is refused with a clear error: All four sub-requirements verified live + by fresh test run. (1) IDEMPOTENT DECLARE + LIVE EXPOSURE: auger.py:97-101 adds COLS['bundle']=(id,name,description,contract,status) and COLS['bundle_member']=(id,bundle_id,project,role,note); auger.py:74 adds 'scope' as decision's last column; auger.py:850-873 cmd_init rewrites a declaration only when its text differs. Live: `python3 auger.py -n auger-eval-247512 init` -> 'declared: 13/13 tables -> ... bundle, bundle_member ...'; a second init -> 'existing' with NO 'wrote declarations' line (idempotent). Live GET /api/ns/<ns>/tables returned status 200 with bundle=['id','name','description','contract','status'], bundle_member=['id','bundle_id','project','role','note'], decision=[...,'scope']. (2) BUNDLE SCOPE ROUND-TRIP: `auger answer --id D-010 --scope bundle` -> 'D-010 recorded (... scope bundle)'; stored row scope=='bundle' and auger.decision_scope(row)=='bundle'; test_a_bundle_scoped_decision_round_trips_through_the_api also asserts the on-disk decision.jsonl. (3) DEFAULT PROJECT, NO BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: auger.py:118-119 DECISION_SCOPES/DEFAULT_SCOPE, auger.py:985-992 decision_scope() is the single reader, auger.py:1033-1034 sends the scope key ONLY when non-default. Live: `auger answer --id D-011` (no --scope) -> 'scope project' and the stored row's scope is None (key never written); test_the_default_decision_scope_is_project_and_sends_no_scope_key asserts the JSONL carries no scope value, and test_a_namespace_declared_before_scope_keeps_working proves a pre-AUG-009 namespace keeps working unchanged (bundle scope downgraded with an explicit WARNING, never silently). (4) ABSENT PROJECT REFUSED: auger.py:435-476 bundle_member() checks known_projects() (auger.py:348-406, read-only sqlite mode=ro). Live: auger.bundle_member(ns,'B-000001','no-such-project-zzz','consumer') raised SystemExit "refused: project 'no-such-project-zzz' has no row in the fleet's scheduler projects table (/home/kara/.hermes/coding-hermes/scheduler.db) — a bundle member names a project the fleet has, and this name is not one", and bundle_member rows stayed []. TEST EVIDENCE (fresh, cache-defeating): `bash tests/gate.sh` (the .gitreins/config.yaml test_command) -> exit 0, 'GATE PASS', '== pytest ==' -> '45 passed in 54.29s', smoke -> 'passed 15, failed 0'; ruff 'All checks passed!'. Targeted `python3 -m pytest tests/test_auger.py -q -k "bundle or scope or init_declares" -rs` -> '11 passed, 34 deselected' with no skips. LSP diagnostics: 0 findings.
auger init idempotently declares bundle/bundle_member and decision.scope (live at /api/ns/<ns>/tables), bundle scope round-trips intact, the default stays project with an unchanged payload, and a member naming a non-fleet project is refused clearly — all confirmed by a fresh GATE PASS (45 pytest, 15/15 smoke) plus live CLI/API checks.
